```{r}
# Load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(viridisLite)
library(sf)
library(mapview)
library(htmltools)
library(DT)
library(here)
library(conflicted)

# Declare package conflict preferences
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter())

# Prevent mapview from dynamically switching to dark maps based on point color contrast
mapviewOptions(basemaps.color.shuffle = FALSE)
```

# Import and Prepare Data

```{r}
# Import continuous WQ station coordinates
sf_stations <- read_sf(
  here("data/processed/spatial/first_flush_spatial_data.gpkg"),
  layer = "cont_wq_stations"
)

# Import continuous WQ station metadata
df_metadata <- readRDS(here("data/processed/wq/cont_wq_metadata.rds"))

# Add metadata to station coordinates
sf_stations_c1 <- sf_stations %>%
  left_join(df_metadata, by = join_by(Survey, Data_Source, Station_ID)) %>%
  relocate(Station_Name, .after = Station_ID) %>%
  mutate(
    across(where(is.Date), \(x) format(x, "%Y-%m-%d")),
    Survey = factor(Survey)
  )

# Import Strata polygons
sf_strata <-
  read_sf(
    here("data/processed/spatial/first_flush_spatial_data.gpkg"),
    layer = "design_strata"
  ) |>
  filter(!Stratum %in% c("Out of Bounds", "Central SF Bay", "South SF Bay"))

# Create color palettes for station points (using Survey) and region polygons
survey_names <- levels(sf_stations_c1$Survey)
pal_stations <-
  plasma(n = length(survey_names)) |>
  setNames(survey_names)
```

# Interactive Maps

```{r}
ndf_maps <- sf_stations_c1 %>%
  nest(sf_data = everything(), .by = Parameter) %>%
  mutate(sf_data = map(sf_data, \(x) mutate(x, Survey = fct_drop(Survey)))) |>
  arrange(Parameter) %>%
  mutate(
    maps = map(
      sf_data,
      \(sf_obj) {
        local_levels <- levels(sf_obj$Survey)
        local_colors <- pal_stations[local_levels]

        mapview(
          sf_obj,
          zcol = "Survey",
          col.regions = unname(local_colors),
          label = "Station_Name",
          layer.name = "Survey",
          cex = 5
        ) +
          mapview(
            sf_strata,
            label = "Stratum",
            layer.name = "Strata",
            alpha.regions = 0.4,
            legend = FALSE
          )
      }
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| include: false
# Invisible step to force Quarto/Knitr to load mapview & leaflet HTML dependencies
tagList(ndf_maps$maps[[1]]@map)
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
# Loop through each row of the nested data frame
for (i in seq_len(nrow(ndf_maps))) {
  # Grab the current Parameter name and corresponding map object
  current_parameter <- ndf_maps$Parameter[i]
  current_map <- ndf_maps$maps[[i]]

  # Print the tab header
  cat("## ", current_parameter, "\n\n")

  # Render the interactive map
  # Convert the S4 mapview object into a standard S3 leaflet widget
  leaflet_widget <- current_map@map

  # Adjust dimensions
  leaflet_widget$width <- "100%"
  leaflet_widget$height <- 600

  # Wrap the mapview object in a tagList and print it
  map_html <- tagList(leaflet_widget)
  print(map_html)

  cat("\n\n")
}
```

:::

# Station Metadata

```{r}
sf_stations_c1 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(-Station_ID) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(Start, End), ymd),
    across(c(Survey, Data_Source, Stratum, Parameter, Interval), factor)
  ) %>%
  datatable(filter = "top")
```
